hypotheses.T0_typed_edges_partition_attention: Keeping every typed edge reproduces the exact local operator sketch with maximum relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.T1_top128_types_are_sufficient: A discovery-selected 128-type vocabulary recovers at least 80 percent of the attention-dependent operator effect at every layer.
hypotheses.T2_top128_types_beat_random: Top-128 recovery exceeds matched random-support p95 by at least 0.10 in at least four layers.
hypotheses.T3_top32_types_are_useful: Top-32 recovery reaches at least 50 percent in at least four layers.
hypotheses.T4_middle_layers_require_broader_vocabul: Mean top-32 recovery at Layers 2-4 is at least 0.15 below the mean at Layers 0, 1, and 5.
hypotheses.T5_fixed_typed_vocabulary_generalizes: Every layer's discovery-ranked support has positive held-out recovery at every reported budget.
